caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bowl shown from two perspectives: a top-down view and a side view. The bowl is round with a shallow depth and has two small handles on either side. Its color palette includes shades of yellow, brown, green, and hints of reddish tones, with a glazed appearance suggesting light reflections. In the top view, the inside of the bowl features a central design consisting of the year "1793" and a pair of crossed objects resembling scissors or shears, all rendered in brown. Around the inner rim, there is a decorative inscription in German written in a calligraphic script. The side view shows the bowl's profile, including the handles and an ornamental floral or foliage pattern painted in brown on a yellow background. The exterior and interior surfaces of the bowl both exhibit painted decorations, and the whole composition is set against a plain, unadorned background. Shadows cast by the bowl suggest a light source from the upper right area.
title: Pa. German Shaving Basin
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
